Split samples into high and low expressers of a gene or signature

Source: R/tcga.R
stratify_by_expression.Rd

Ranks samples by the expression of one gene, or by a signature score for several genes (the mean of each gene's z-score across samples), and returns the samples in the top and bottom quantile.

Usage

stratify_by_expression(expr, genes, quantile = 0.25)

Arguments

expr

Numeric matrix or data frame of expression (genes x samples), with gene symbols as row names and sample identifiers as column names.

genes

One or more gene symbols present in rownames(expr).

quantile

Fraction of samples in each tail; 0.25 gives the upper and lower quartiles.

Value

A list with the sample names in high and low, and the per-sample score used for ranking.

Examples

set.seed(1)
expr <- matrix(rexp(200), nrow = 4,
               dimnames = list(c("NKG7", "GZMB", "CD3E", "ACTB"), paste0("s", 1:50)))
strata <- stratify_by_expression(expr, "NKG7")
lengths(strata[c("high", "low")])
#> high  low 
#>   13   13 
stratify_by_expression(expr, c("NKG7", "GZMB"))$high
#>  [1] "s2"  "s4"  "s6"  "s14" "s17" "s19" "s22" "s23" "s27" "s38" "s39" "s43"
#> [13] "s44"
